==='''Brandon's Wheel of Time Reread on Twitter - 5 January 2011'''===

[http://twitter.com/Janasedai/status/22557584548433920 Deadsy on Twitter - 5 January 2011]
Can you just re-read books 1-5 over and over so we can keep talking about Moiraine?

[http://twitter.com/Janasedai/status/22557727381258241 Deadsy]
If not that, perhaps I can try to force you to dwell on later mentions of Moiraine, no matter how unimportant.

[http://twitter.com/Janasedai/status/22557887633035264 Deadsy]
...and it took me a long time but I've narrowed the "something" about Moiraine down to the fact she rarely uses contractions.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22724592099401728 Brandon]
Let me know what you find. One thing to note--RJ didn't use contractions in narrative, but I do. A stylistic difference.

[http://twitter.com/Janasedai/status/22783404151939073 Deadsy]
I noticed it in TGH with Moiraine and Siuan. Siuan uses them left and right because she's not uppity enough to say "do not".

[http://twitter.com/Terez27/status/22800210128281601 Terez]
It's a good point, and probably part of that Cairhienin reserve. Or at least, it helps portray it.

[http://twitter.com/evestay/status/22566337771474944 Steve]
Do the WoT eBooks include proper italics and chapter icons?

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22726245066215424 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22789081863815168 Brandon]
Ha. I love bureaucracy. Me to Tor: Hey, I need the wot ebooks. Tor: Just buy them and we'll reimburse you. It's easier that way.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22941549394395136 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22728503791190017 Brandon]
People (mostly my editor) complain about my capitalization of magic-related terms. (Push and Pull in Mistborn.) I learned from RJ.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22729097675284480 Brandon]
I'll admit, keeping track of which terms are upper case while writing these can be hard. Warder, for example, is capitalized.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22747142590308352 Brandon]
Ha. I love @[http://twitter.com/GrammarGirl GrammarGirl]. She says: "Refer your editor to the section on capitalizing Platonic ideals: http://j.mp/18T09Z

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22738711972159489 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22739093188247552 Brandon]
Maria says she thinks that what I'm using is a file scanned from print. Trollop/Trolloc makes more sense now.

'''''Non Sequituri'''''

[http://twitter.com/FelixPax/status/22741461552332800 Felix on Twitter - 5 January 2011]
Did RJ specifically state in his notes that the three Aiel Dreamwalkers were clueless about the 'breaking of the seals'?

[http://twitter.com/FelixPax/status/22741806248628224 Felix]
I ask, because those same 3 Aiel Dreamwalkers are implied to know the final use of Callandor early in the series.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22753027668574209 Brandon]
Before I reply, expand on that question, if you will. Humor me.

[http://twitter.com/FelixPax/status/22761000763654144 Felix]
It's Amys, Bair, Melaine reactions to Egwene's words in [http://twitter.com/#%21/search?q=%23TofM #TofM] Chapter "A Vow" (Egwene pov) I'm wondering about.

[http://twitter.com/FelixPax/status/22761376757841920 Felix]
Quotation: "but his words were those of madness. He said he is going to break the seals on the Dark One's prison."

[http://twitter.com/FelixPax/status/22761723895218176 Felix]
Amys and Bair both froze. "You are certain of this?" Bair asked. "Yes.

[http://twitter.com/FelixPax/status/22762071552696320 Felix]
"This is disturbing news," Amys said."We will consult with him on this. Thank you for bringing this to us."

[http://twitter.com/FelixPax/status/22762752325980160 Felix]
My question is if all the Wise One sit around the Heart of the Stone, repeatedly, and look at ''Callandor''.

[http://twitter.com/FelixPax/status/22763199036137472 Felix]
Should not the Wise Ones have knowledge about the breaking of the seals? They already know about ''Callandor'''s use.<sup>[https://docs.google.com/View?docID=0ARw8aVNqPsL5ZGNqc3BqcWdfODdkZ3F2OWhjNQ&revision=_latest#FOOTNOTE-1 1]</sup>

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22765481039499264 Brandon]
I'll say this. RJ's writing, notes, and outline were very present in that entire sequence. Much less Brandon there.

[http://twitter.com/elektrotal/status/22733388402135041 Shivam Bhatt]
Why did you use the word 'magic' in ToM? It never showed up in WoT before that.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22748100116357120 Brandon]
RJ used the word a couple of times in the series.

[http://twitter.com/elektrotal/status/22749732912758784 Shivam Bhatt]
Did he? Because I remember being jarred out of the narrative when I saw it mentioned in ToM. Seemed really incongruous.

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22759168343539712 Brandon]
Yeah, a couple of times. Mostly in earlier books. In Aviendha's vision, though, it was supposed to be incongruous.

[http://twitter.com/TankSpill/status/22814218143141888 Emil Schuffhausen]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22939036595257344 Brandon]

[http://twitter.com/BrandonSandrson/status/22939131277484032 Brandon]
